objective: Freeze the auditable rule set, decision states, authority boundaries and downgrade semantics for converting accepted HKCU P2B research-ready securities into formal Hong Kong Candidate Pool proposals in later Phase-3 gates, without graduating or mutating any security in P3-0.

graduation_rules.name: ACCEPTED_P2B_FINAL_LINEAGE
graduation_rules.requirement: Security must originate from the accepted P2B Final 77-security cross-sectional surface and preserve P2A/P2B lineage without re-scoring.

graduation_rules.name: NO_RETAINED_INVESTMENT_BLOCKER
graduation_rules.requirement: A security with HOLD_RETAINED_INVESTMENT_BLOCKER cannot graduate until the blocker is independently resolved in a later evidence cycle.

graduation_rules.name: CURRENT_INVESTABILITY_AND_BUY_ELIGIBILITY
graduation_rules.requirement: Security must remain publication-eligible, buy-eligible and investable under the accepted HKCU eligibility surface; sell-only or ineligible securities cannot graduate.

graduation_rules.name: DECISION_GRADE_MARKET_AND_FACTOR_FRESHNESS
graduation_rules.requirement: Market/factor observations used for graduation must satisfy the accepted freshness contract for the assessment as-of date; stale decision inputs fail closed.

graduation_rules.name: TRANSACTION_TAX_EVIDENCE_COMPLETE
graduation_rules.requirement: Accepted transaction-cost and tax evidence must remain EVIDENCE_COMPLETE; execution frictions are context and never alpha.

graduation_rules.name: THREE_COMPANY_DIMENSIONS_SYNTHESIZED
graduation_rules.requirement: Governance/Value-Trap, Earnings-Expectation Revision and Catalyst dimensions must each have an accepted decision synthesis with no RESEARCH_REQUIRED residue.

graduation_rules.name: GOVERNANCE_VALUE_TRAP_NOT_SUBSTANTIVELY_BLOCKED
graduation_rules.requirement: No unresolved material governance, related-party, auditor, control or value-trap event may remain a substantive investment blocker.

graduation_rules.name: EARNINGS_RISK_NOT_SUBSTANTIVELY_BLOCKED
graduation_rules.requirement: No current material negative earnings alert, warning or equivalent decision-critical earnings event may remain an unresolved substantive blocker.

graduation_rules.name: LIQUIDITY_AND_TRADABILITY_ACCEPTED
graduation_rules.requirement: Accepted HKCU/P2A liquidity and active-trading eligibility must remain valid; Phase 3 may not invent a lower tradability threshold to force graduation.

graduation_rules.name: VALUATION_SUPPORT_EXPLICIT
graduation_rules.requirement: Assessment must state a security-specific valuation support state using accepted valuation context; A/H discount alone cannot satisfy the rule and missing valuation cannot be neutral-filled.

graduation_rules.name: THESIS_FALSIFIER_AND_MONITOR_TRIGGER_EXPLICIT
graduation_rules.requirement: Assessment must materialize the investment thesis, principal downside/falsifier and at least one monitor trigger tied to accepted evidence.

graduation_rules.name: CROSS_LISTING_AND_DUPLICATE_EXPOSURE_REVIEW
graduation_rules.requirement: Where an A/H pair or existing cross-market exposure exists, graduation must explicitly review duplicate exposure and relative-value context; duplication is not automatically a rejection and A/H spread is not alpha.

assessment_routing.PROPOSE_CORE_CANDIDATE: All applicable hard rules pass; valuation support is not adverse; thesis/falsifier/monitor package is complete; no unresolved material confidence cap prevents a core designation.
assessment_routing.PROPOSE_WATCH_CANDIDATE: All applicable hard rules pass, but one or more bounded confidence caps, valuation uncertainty, event timing or thesis-monitor conditions justify watch status rather than core status.
assessment_routing.DEFER_RESEARCH_MONITOR: No retained investment blocker exists, but one or more required graduation decision fields are incomplete or not decision-grade; do not force a pass.
assessment_routing.HOLD_RETAINED_INVESTMENT_BLOCKER: A substantive investment blocker remains; security cannot enter Candidate promotion while the blocker persists.
